messages:
Alex: Quick Q — external audit team needs console access to view app logs for last 30 days. They should NOT see PII. What's the least-privileged way to do this? Project Viewer feels too broad.

Marta: Are they on GCP or AWS? Also temporary or ongoing?

Alex: GCP. Temp access, 48h window. They only need to query the exported logs in BigQuery and the Logs Viewer in console.

Jamal: Agree don't give Project Viewer. Two safer options: 1) Create a redacted sink that exports PII-stripped logs to a dataset and give the auditors BigQuery Data Viewer on that dataset + logging.viewer on the project. 2) Create a custom role scoped to only logging.logEntries.list + bigquery.jobs.create/bigquery.tables.getData on the exported dataset and grant it for 48h.

Lina: If you go custom role, keep it tight. Example minimal bindings: `roles/logging.viewer` on the specific project + `roles/bigquery.dataViewer` but ONLY on the redacted dataset. Don't grant dataset-level OWNER.

Alex: Can you share a quick example command for granting a temporary binding? I can submit the access request and tag the auditors.

Jamal: Sure. For quick JIT binding we do:
```
# grant role on dataset
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding my-project \
  --member='user:auditor@example.com' \
  --role='roles/logging.viewer' 

# dataset-level binding
bq add-iam-policy-binding redacted_logs_dataset \
  --member=user:auditor@example.com --role=READER
```
Then add an expiration annotation in the ticket and remove binding after 48h. (We don't have org-wide time-limited bindings turned on yet.)

Marta: Another pattern — create a temporary service account, grant it the minimal roles, and provide auditors a signed URL or short-lived key via our access flow. That avoids tying to individual external accounts.

Lina: If you can, prefer the redacted sink path. It's the lowest risk for accidental exposure. Open a ticket and @eng-sre to set up the sink. Include the PII fields to scrub.

Alex: Will do. I'll open the ticket and set the expiration. @Jamal can you draft the custom role JSON snippet for the ticket?

Jamal: On it. Draft will include only: `logging.logEntries.list`, `bigquery.tables.getData`, `bigquery.jobs.create` scoped to the dataset and a note: no write perms.

security-bot: Access request created: AUDIT-2026-134 (48h) — added watchers: @Lina, @Marta :eyes:

Alex: Thanks all — filing ticket now, assigning to @eng-sre and attaching this thread. I'll paste the redaction fields and the auditor emails in the ticket. (reaction :thumbsup:)
